page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; a faint margin of show-through from the facing page at right (not transcribed); digitiser credit below the scan (not transcribed).

main_text.p: Video, judices, ejecto Pantomimo, exterminato Mangone, evulsis simul eorum de libris nostris, dictatis, commentis, & placitis, Scholasticam pene totam cum illis abiisse Philosophiam, & de turgentibus illis in Bibliotheca volumi-nibus, non nisi exiguam superesse faraginem :, Vix quidquam comperio reliquum, præter Axiomata quædam (ut præ se ferunt) Communes Notiones, & Generales Regulas: In his tamen etiamnum aliquid, quod à Ratione non est: Genius iterum aliquis subolet mihi: exerat se de

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page is visible at the right edge and was omitted. The catchword "de" stands at the right below the last line; it is given here as the last word of the text rather than as a catchword element. Possible doubtful readings: "faraginem :," with a colon-like mark after it, and "evulsis" with the long s as printed.
